# Mighty Networks

Manage members, spaces, content, events, plans, and other administrative resources in a Mighty Network through its GA Admin REST API.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/mighty-networks/.

## Actions

- **Add Member to Space**: Add an existing member of the connected Mighty Network to a space, granting that member access to the space.
- **Create Event**: Create a one-time or recurring visible event in a Mighty Networks space.
- **Create Invite**: Create an invitation to the connected Mighty Network.
- **Create Member**: Create a full Network member or a limited member assigned to specified spaces.
- **Create Post**: Create and publish a visible post or article in a Mighty Networks space.
- **Get Event** (read-only): Return details for one Mighty Networks event by ID.
- **Get Member** (read-only): Return one member in the connected Mighty Network by member ID or exact email address.
- **Get Network** (read-only): Return identity and profile details for the Network connected to this Admin API key.
- **Get Post** (read-only): Return details for one Mighty Networks post or article by ID.
- **Get Space** (read-only): Return details for one space in the connected Mighty Network by ID.
- **List Abuse Reports** (read-only): Return one page of abuse reports for moderation review.
- **List Collections** (read-only): Return one page of collections that organize spaces in the connected Mighty Network.
- **List Event RSVPs** (read-only): Return one page of RSVP records for an event in the connected Mighty Network.
- **List Events** (read-only): Return one page of events in the connected Mighty Network.
- **List Invites** (read-only): Return one page of Network invitations, optionally filtered by recipient email.
- **List Members** (read-only): Return one page of members in the connected Mighty Network.
- **List Plans** (read-only): Return one page of access and payment plans configured for the connected Mighty Network.
- **List Posts** (read-only): Return one page of posts across the connected Mighty Network.
- **List Spaces** (read-only): Return one page of spaces in the connected Mighty Network.
- **Remove Member from Space**: Remove an existing member from a space without deleting the member's Network account.
- **Revoke Invite**: Revoke an unaccepted invitation to the connected Mighty Network.
- **Set Event RSVP**: Create or update a Mighty Networks member's RSVP for an event.
- **Update Member**: Update selected profile or Network role fields for an existing member.
- **Update Post**: Update the title and/or body of an existing Mighty Networks post or article.
